steps.journalDescription: Chief Tabor sent me to get my lunch from the mess hall while he deals with something. I should head to the mess hall in the southeast corner of the camp and speak to the cook there. Once I'm finished with that, I should return to Chief Tabor in the northeast section of the camp.
I should meet with Chief Tabor in the northeast section of the camp.

Chief Tabor and Captain Adéla told me that a squad of guards have been taken hostage by a group of branded. The branded are digging a tunnel out of the camp and are using the hostages to stall for time. I should enter the southern most hut in the northeast corner of the camp to begin the negotiations.
